# WO-007: Make the v0.2 developer first-run examples actionable
Status: open
Vendor: codex
Agent: web-builder
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (check-ins via tools/vendor.sh)

## Goal
Kai Nakamura: update the existing developer page's first-run and JSON
reference sections to match the implemented v0.2 CLI, while clearly
keeping v0.2 marked as coming. One or two sessions.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- Replace the statement that the config format will be published with
  clearly named links to the existing versioned setup schema and fake
  example YAML in the repository. Use the existing repository URL helper.
- Show a validation-first example using `freemyid setup --from config.yaml
  --check`, followed by interactive confirmation. Explain that validation
  saves nothing. Do not add `--yes` or invent a new setup flow.
- Describe existing behavior from docs/CLI.md without changing permission,
  consent, mailbox, or practice-mode instructions. Flag source conflicts.
- In the JSON section, show a read-only `status --json` example and explain
  one JSON object on stdout, human messages on stderr, and versioned schemas.
  Link the existing CLI reference for exit codes rather than duplicating it.
- Add repository source comments for changed claims. Preserve the coming
  labels: implementation on main is not evidence of a published release.
- Preserve existing IDs, metadata, download controls, account-free support,
  and all other page sections. No prices, release dates, or paid-tier copy.
- Add regression tests against web/dist/developers/index.html for the
  schema/example links, validation command, JSON guidance, and coming label.
  Tests must not execute the displayed commands or use legacy site output.
- Run `pnpm --dir web build`, `pnpm --dir web check`, the content-check
  command documented in docs/handoff/web-v3.md, and
  `.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/test_web_developer_first_run.py`.
  Report inherited failures and unavailable dependencies; do not install.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- web/src/pages/developers/index.astro
- tests/test_web_developer_first_run.py

## Out of scope / do not touch
Everything else, including shared components/styles, site data, release
metadata, schema and example files, CLI docs (reserved by WO-002), app
code, security and secrets guidance, scheduling examples, registry,
CI/release, dependencies, and every other open work order's files.
No JavaScript, network, package installs, git, or command execution from
page examples. Read docs/handoff/web-v3.md and docs/POSITIONING.md first.

## Check-in plan
After session one: provide changed copy, source references, and built-HTML
test results. At completion: report build/content/CSP/link/budget checks
and unresolved source conflicts. Stop at the allowed paths.
